backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, conversations, messages, and PIN management with role-based access control. Stores per-user conversation maps and provides CRUD operations for messages and conversations.
backend/migration.mo: Empty migration module that passes through state unchanged, serving as a placeholder for future data migrations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: conversation management, message display, PDF export, message search, and date-range filtering with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components, utilities, and configuration files describing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables including coral accent colors and sidebar styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up QueryClient, InternetIdentity, ThemeProvider, and rendering the app structure with Header, Footer, and nested authentication/PIN/profile gates around ConversationManager.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Authentication gate component that displays loading state, login prompt with Internet Identity button, or renders children when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/ConversationList: Sidebar component displaying conversation list with create dialog, handling conversation selection and creation with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/ExportButton.tsx: A dialog-based component that allows users to export a single conversation to PDF with optional date range filtering. Handles PDF generation, date filtering, and displays loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the application footer with copyright information and a branded link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the application header with branding (logo and title), theme toggle, and login button.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Manages Internet Identity authentication with login/logout functionality, handles authentication state, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.ts: Renders an individual message with sender name, timestamp, and text content. Supports search term highlighting within sender and message text.
frontend/src/components/MessageInput.tsx: A form component for adding new messages to a conversation with fields for sender name, timestamp, and message text. Validates input and handles submission with loading states.
frontend/src/components/MessageList.tsx: Displays a scrollable list of messages using MessageBubble components with auto-scroll to bottom on new messages. Shows empty state when no messages exist.
frontend/src/components/MessageSearch.ts: A search input component with clear button that allows users to filter messages by search term.
frontend/src/components/MultiConversatio: A dialog component that allows users to select multiple conversations via checkboxes and export them together as a single PDF document.
frontend/src/components/PinEntry.tsx: Displays a PIN entry form with 6-digit OTP input for unlocking access to conversations. Tracks failed attempts and handles PIN verification.
frontend/src/components/PinGate.tsx: A security gate component that checks if user has a PIN set, shows setup if needed, or prompts for PIN entry before allowing access to children components. Uses session storage to persist verification state.
frontend/src/components/PinSetup.tsx: React component that renders a form for creating and confirming a 4-6 digit PIN with validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: React component that displays a modal dialog for first-time users to enter their name and create a profile before accessing the app.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: React component that provides a button to toggle between light and dark themes using next-themes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance, creating it with the current identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, PIN management, conversations, and messages, wrapping backend actor calls with caching and mutation handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, including coral accent colors and typography settings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/ConversationManager.t: Main page component that manages conversation selection, message display, search, and export functionality with a sidebar for conversation list and main content area for messages and input.
frontend/src/utils/pdfGenerator.ts: Utility for generating PDF exports of conversations by creating HTML content in a new window and triggering the browser's print dialog with formatted conversation data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, including coral and amber palettes, sidebar colors, and design system tokens for the application theme.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a web-based conversation collector app for Internet Computer blockchain that allows manual message input and PDF export, with architectural notes emphasizing offline-only operation and responsive design.
